title: thelypteris gaudichaudii
intro: Thelypteris gaudichaudii, commonly known as the Guadalupe Rattlesnake Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris gaudichaudii include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and potential interactions.
